image_description: A close-up, angled view of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is primarily white/translucent plastic with a red and white paper label wrapped around the spine and face. The label features repeated text 'MAGNETIC TAPE' and '120'. A blue circular hub is visible on the top spool. The bottom edge shows the rectangular opening for the tape head. There are some visual distortions in the text rendering and slight warping of the cassette's rectangular geometry.
